events.title: Closed Beta Test

We want our future players to share their honest feedback on the current gameplay and help us shape the final version of Red Recon. events.title: Closed Playtest of the New Version in March
events.summary: Important News! First, the early version of Red Recon: 1944 will be removed from Steam this Friday, March 6. The next public build will become available this summer during the Steam Next Fest Second, we’re planning a closed playtest of the new version at the end of March. Players will be able to apply via the game’s Steam page. events.title: Red Recon: 1944 first playtest begins!
events.summary: Today the very first playtest for Red Recon: 1944 begins! Head over to the game’s Steam page, click the big green "Request Access" button, and download the game. After that — you’re good to go!During the playtest you’ll complete training at a military camp near Pskov and carry out your first combat mission.
